name: Link Prediction
problem_statement: Score and rank currently unconnected vertex pairs according to a declared structural link-prediction measure.

normalization: Remove self-loops from the structural scoring graph.
Collapse duplicate structural edges while retaining any separately applied temporal filter.
Preserve direction only for measures explicitly defined for directed pairs.

problem_inputs.name: scoring_measure
problem_inputs.description: Structural definition used to assign pair scores.

problem_inputs.name: candidate_pairs
problem_inputs.description: Pairs to evaluate; null means all permitted nonedges after filters.

problem_inputs.name: exclude_existing_edges
problem_inputs.description: Exclude pairs already connected in the scoring graph.

required_outputs.name: ranked_predictions
required_outputs.description: Candidate pair, score, and rank in descending score order.

required_outputs.name: evaluated_candidate_count
required_outputs.description: Number of distinct candidate pairs scored.

required_outputs.name: complete
required_outputs.description: Whether every permitted candidate was evaluated before selecting top_k.

optional_outputs.name: score_components
optional_outputs.description: Interpretable terms such as common-neighbor IDs or degree contributions.

optional_outputs.name: evaluation_against_ground_truth
optional_outputs.description: Precision, recall, MAP, or AUC when a held-out future-edge set is supplied externally.

solution_semantics.objective: Rank eligible distinct pairs by the exact selected structural score, not by a claim of guaranteed future connection.
solution_semantics.exactness: complete=true means all eligible candidates were scored before top-k selection.
solution_semantics.duplicate_policy: Undirected pairs are canonicalized and appear once; directed ordered pairs remain distinct.
solution_semantics.ordering: Descending score with a stable pair-ID tie break.

validation_rules: Every returned endpoint exists and satisfies candidate filters.
Existing edges are absent when exclusion is enabled.
Scores recompute exactly under the selected measure.
Ranks follow score and tie policy.
edge_cases: A complete graph has no eligible nonedge predictions when existing edges are excluded.
Pairs with no relevant shared structure may receive zero score.
If fewer than top_k candidates exist, return all of them.
